scripts.initialize:
set -euo pipefail
export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
corepack enable 2>/dev/null || sudo corepack enable
stamp=$(cat package.json yarn.lock .yarnrc.yml | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ -d node_modules ] && [ "$(cat node_modules/.capy-install-stamp 2>/dev/null)" = "$stamp" ]; then echo "deps unchanged"; exit 0; fi
corepack yarn install --immutable
echo "$stamp" > node_modules/.capy-install-stamp
